title: Cosmetics Catalogue
summary: Every named cosmetic confirmed in the network's current configuration: hats, back/body cosmetics, a balloon, and off-hand items, made at the crafting altar (see the Cosmetics & Crafting Altar system). Despite the filename, these are network-wide items — anything crafted on one server can be worn on any of them. A few are exclusive to Diamond Trophy's own materials, and one (Headphones) is not craftable at all and only comes from a Rare Crate.
how_to_access: Craft most of these at the crafting altar (right-click the furniture, or /altar for MVIP+). Equip owned ones from the profile menu's Cosmetics button (/cosmetics) or the in-world wardrobe.

entries.name: Golden Crown
entries.description: A heavy, ornate golden crown. The network's flagship legendary hat.
entries.how_to_get: Craft at the altar once you own its Blueprint (a permanent unlock item that drops rarely from a Rare Crate). The craft itself needs a very large amount of common gathering material plus leather, forged steel, and a small amount of two rarer crafting dusts, and also costs a sizeable chunk of network coins.
entries.how_to_use: Once crafted, equip it from the Cosmetics menu; it's worn in your actual helmet slot.
entries.icon_hint: an ornate golden crown with small jewels, styled like a golden helmet
entries.notes: Legendary rarity; a Legendary-tier craft takes roughly 12 hours to finish unless the recipe says otherwise.

entries.name: Headphones
entries.description: A pair of over-ear headphones worn as a hat.
entries.how_to_get: Not craftable at the altar at all — the only confirmed way to get this is a rare pull from a Rare Crate's chase rewards.
entries.how_to_use: Equip from the Cosmetics menu once owned; worn in the helmet slot.
entries.icon_hint: purple over-ear headphones worn like a hat, no visible cable
entries.notes: No rarity tier is shown for it in the current configuration, so none is listed here.

entries.name: Top Hat
entries.description: A tall, formal top hat. Flavor text calls it dressing up "for formal parkour."
entries.how_to_get: Craft at the altar. Needs a solid amount of common gathering material, some leather, and a little glass shard material.
entries.how_to_use: Equip from the Cosmetics menu once owned; worn in the helmet slot.
entries.icon_hint: a sky-blue silk top hat with a thin band

entries.name: Pumpkin Hat
entries.description: A carved pumpkin worn as a hat, joked about as "seasonal, in the sense that you decide the season."
entries.how_to_get: Craft at the altar. Needs a modest amount of common gathering material and a little of the "warm" crafting powder.
entries.how_to_use: Equip from the Cosmetics menu once owned; worn in the helmet slot.
entries.icon_hint: a carved jack-o'-lantern pumpkin worn as a hat, orange with a green stem

entries.name: Goblin Crown
entries.description: A crude crown described as "taken from a goblin who was not using it."
entries.how_to_get: Craft at the altar using goblin-skin material (a Diamond Trophy monster drop) plus common gathering material and a moderate amount of network coins.
entries.how_to_use: Equip from the Cosmetics menu once owned; worn in the helmet slot.
entries.icon_hint: a rough, slightly crooked golden crown with a scavenged look
entries.notes: Rare rarity. Its materials only drop on Diamond Trophy, but like every cosmetic here it can be worn on any server once you own it.

entries.name: Orange Bucket
entries.description: A plain orange plastic bucket, worn upside-down as a hat. Described in the altar's own recipe notes as "nobody asked for this. You found it anyway."
entries.how_to_get: Craft at the altar using only Orange Plastic — an extremely rare Diamond Trophy easter-egg material (a small chance from smashing pots, or a rarer boss drop). The recipe itself needs very few of it.
entries.how_to_use: Equip from the Cosmetics menu once owned; worn in the helmet slot.
entries.icon_hint: a plain orange plastic bucket worn upside-down as a hat
entries.notes: Marked Legendary rarity despite the tiny recipe — the joke is that Orange Plastic itself is the hard part to find. Materials are Diamond Trophy-exclusive; the cosmetic can still be worn anywhere.

entries.name: Turtle Shell
entries.description: A shell worn on the back, joked about as "portable cover, questionable speed."
entries.how_to_get: Craft at the altar using a solid amount of common gathering material, the "cold" crafting powder, and a little forged steel.
entries.how_to_use: Equip from the Cosmetics menu once owned; renders on your back.
entries.icon_hint: a rounded blue-green turtle shell worn on the back like a helmet/backpack

entries.name: Jetpack
entries.description: A back-mounted jetpack, described as "does not actually fly. Looks like it might."
entries.how_to_get: Craft at the altar once you own its Blueprint (drops from a Rare Crate). Needs a large amount of common gathering material, the "warm" crafting powder, forged steel, a little of the rarer rainbow powder, and a chunk of network coins.
entries.how_to_use: Equip from the Cosmetics menu once owned; renders on your back.
entries.icon_hint: a chunky purple-and-metal jetpack with two small fire-jet exhausts

entries.name: Angel Wings
entries.description: A full pair of feathered angel wings, described simply as "the long one. Worth it."
entries.how_to_get: Craft at the altar once you own its Blueprint (a very rare Rare Crate find). The recipe needs a very large amount of common gathering material, several rarer crafting materials including luck essence and star dust, and the largest coin cost of any cosmetic recipe currently configured.
entries.how_to_use: Equip from the Cosmetics menu once owned; renders on your back.
entries.icon_hint: a full pair of large white-and-pink feathered angel wings

entries.name: Cannon Pack
entries.description: A back-mounted mini cannon, described as "still warm from the Goblin King's cannonade."
entries.how_to_get: Craft at the altar using cannon-ash material (dropped only by Diamond Trophy's boss fight) plus goblin-skin material, common gathering material, and a chunk of network coins.
entries.how_to_use: Equip from the Cosmetics menu once owned; renders on your back.
entries.icon_hint: a small soot-blackened cannon strapped to the back like a backpack
entries.notes: Epic rarity. Materials are Diamond Trophy-exclusive; the cosmetic can still be worn anywhere.

entries.name: Blue Balloon
entries.description: A balloon that floats above and follows you on a leash. Described plainly as "it follows you. That is the whole feature."
entries.how_to_get: Craft at the altar using a modest amount of common gathering material and the "cold" crafting powder.
entries.how_to_use: Equip from the Cosmetics menu once owned; floats above your head on a visible leash and can be recoloured (dye support is on for this one).
entries.icon_hint: a light-blue balloon on a string, floating just above where a player's head would be
entries.notes: Uncommon rarity. Currently the only balloon cosmetic confirmed in configuration.

entries.name: Bouquet
entries.description: A small bouquet of flowers, held in the off hand. Described as "someone was thinking of you."
entries.how_to_get: Craft at the altar using a modest amount of common gathering material plus a little leather.
entries.how_to_use: This is a NetworkCore-only off-hand cosmetic (CosmeticsCore has no off-hand category). It's meant to render automatically in your off hand whenever that hand is empty — but see the open question below about whether that path currently works for a player to select/use.
entries.icon_hint: a small hand-held bouquet of colourful flowers
entries.notes: Uncommon rarity. As of this audit, no in-game command or menu was found that lets a player choose which off-hand cosmetic (if any) is actually shown, so whether this currently displays for anyone is unclear — see the system file's open_questions.

entries.name: Lantern
entries.description: A lit lantern, held in the off hand. Described as "warm, and slightly smug about it."
entries.how_to_get: Craft at the altar using a solid amount of common gathering material, the "warm" crafting powder, and a little glow-powder material.
entries.how_to_use: Same off-hand mechanism as Bouquet — see notes.
entries.icon_hint: a small lit lantern with a warm glow, held out in one hand
entries.notes: Rare rarity. Same unresolved off-hand equip question as Bouquet — see the system file's open_questions.

entries.name: Plush
entries.description: A worn plush toy, held in the off hand. Described as "it has seen things."
entries.how_to_get: Craft at the altar once you own its Blueprint (drops from a Rare Crate). Needs a large amount of common gathering material, leather, glow-powder material, and a little luck-essence material, plus a chunk of network coins.
entries.how_to_use: Same off-hand mechanism as Bouquet and Lantern — see notes.
entries.icon_hint: a worn, slightly lumpy plush toy, held in one hand
entries.notes: Epic rarity. Also currently pulled from crate reward pools for the same reason as Bouquet/Lantern — see the system file's open_questions.

open_questions: Whether off-hand cosmetics (Bouquet, Lantern, Plush) can currently be equipped/displayed by a player at all is unresolved — see cosmetics-altar.json's open_questions for detail.
Headphones has no listed rarity tier in configuration.
